title: Launch Day
logline: A startup's earthquake-warning app goes live on the morning of the big one.
plot: Three college dropouts in San Francisco have spent two years and every dollar their investors gave them building an app that can warn phones seconds before an earthquake. Their lead investor wants a flashier product, the board is ready to fire the founder, and the launch party is set for a Monday morning. At 9:41 a.m., as the app goes live to a million users, the San Andreas fault ruptures. Buildings fall, the servers in their basement are failing, and their alerts are the only thing reaching people across a city with no power. Trapped in their collapsing office, the founders must keep the system running and decide who gets warned first.

title: The Equation
logline: In 1962, the first Black physics student at a Mississippi university solves a problem his professors can't, and the state wants him gone.
plot: In 1962, a brilliant young physicist from the Mississippi Delta becomes the first Black graduate student at the state university, escorted onto campus by federal marshals through a crowd of rioters. His advisor, a famous cosmologist, refuses to supervise him, and his classmates won't sit near him. Working alone at night in the library, he solves an equation about the birth of the universe that the department has chased for a decade. When his professor tries to publish the work under his own name, and the governor's men threaten the young man's family, he must fight for his discovery and his right to stay, as the civil rights movement marches through the town.

title: Category Five
logline: Big-wave surfers chase the largest swell ever recorded, straight into a hurricane.
plot: A record-breaking hurricane is spinning toward Hawaii, and meteorologists are ordering everyone off the North Shore. For a handful of professional big-wave surfers, it is also the biggest swell in recorded history, and a surf brand has offered a fortune to whoever rides the largest wave. As the storm intensifies beyond any forecast, a retired champion, her estranged son who is chasing the title, and a rookie with nothing to lose paddle out with jet skis and safety teams. When the storm surge floods the island and the rescue helicopters are grounded, the surfers become the only ones who can reach people trapped along the coast.

title: Trinity in Color
logline: The Army hires a painter to record Los Alamos in 1945. She becomes the only artist to witness the first atomic bomb.
plot: In 1945, Ruth Halloran, a struggling New Mexico landscape painter, is hired by the Army to paint the secret laboratory at Los Alamos for the official record. Forbidden to ask what the scientists are building, she paints the mesa, the barracks and the exhausted physicists, and falls into a friendship with a young chemist who begins to fear the weapon. On the morning of the Trinity test she is driven into the desert to paint the explosion. What she puts on the canvas horrifies the generals, and when they order her paintings destroyed, Ruth must decide whether to hide the only artistic record of the moment the world changed.

title: Township Jazz
logline: In 1976, an American jazz legend touring South Africa must decide whether to play for whites-only crowds.
plot: In 1976, as the apartheid government in Pretoria forces Black South Africans into townships and bans their music from the radio, a young pianist from Soweto plays in illegal shebeens and dreams of leaving. When the government invites an American jazz star for a segregated tour, the pianist is hired as his accompanist. The students of Soweto march against Afrikaans in their schools and the police open fire, and the musicians must decide whether to play the whites-only concert halls or join the protest. A story of jazz, resistance and the musicians who fought apartheid with their songs.

seed: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button (2008)
title: Ingénue
logline: An actress who never ages has played the young lead for a hundred years, under a dozen different names.
plot: Since 1925, the same woman has starred in Hollywood pictures under a dozen different names, playing the young romantic lead in silent films, Technicolor musicals and, today, a streaming series. She does not age. Every twenty years she retires, fakes her death and reinvents herself, leaving behind the directors, husbands and co-stars who grew old. When a young film historian notices that a 1950s starlet and today's breakout actress have the same face, he begins to dig through old studio archives. As he gets closer to the truth, she must decide whether to vanish again or finally let someone see her grow old.

title: Color War
logline: At an elite summer camp, the end-of-summer color war turns out to be a real one.
plot: In a near-future country ruled by a single party, every teenager spends one summer at a state camp, and every camp ends with the color war, broadcast live to the nation. Officially it is capture the flag in the woods. In truth the regime uses it to find soldiers and punish dissent. Tess, a sharp-tongued sixteen-year-old whose parents were arrested for protesting, is placed on the Blue team with a cabin of misfits. When the counselors change the rules and campers begin to disappear in the forest, Tess must lead her cabin through the games, expose the camp on its own broadcast and spark a revolt.

title: Field Guide
logline: An autistic teenager survives alone in the Alaskan wilderness after a plane crash, using the encyclopedia in his head.
plot: Fifteen-year-old Owen, who is autistic and knows every page of his field guide to North American plants and animals by heart, is the only survivor when a bush plane crashes in the Alaskan wilderness. Alone, with no tools and a broken arm, he must find water, build shelter and survive a winter that is coming fast. The routines and knowledge that made him an outsider at school keep him alive: he knows which berries are poisonous and how bears behave. Inspired by real survival stories, the film follows his months alone, while his mother refuses to let the searchers give up.

title: Island 9
logline: In 1944, a squad of Marines sent to an uncharted Pacific island finds it ruled by prehistoric beasts.
plot: In the summer of 1944, a squad of eight Marines is sent to scout an uncharted island in the South Pacific where a reconnaissance plane went down. They expect a Japanese garrison. Instead they find the garrison destroyed, and a jungle full of creatures that have survived since the age of the dinosaurs. With their radio broken and their sergeant wounded, the young Marines must cross the island to reach the downed pilots, forced into an uneasy truce with the last surviving Japanese soldiers, as the creatures hunt them all through the jungle.
